$comment: The only place model ids live. Everything else reads them from here (Terraform, the agent image). A model's own profilePrefix overrides the top-level one (Haiku for Ask Clip Factory and Nova 2 Lite, the second watcher of the deep analysis, use the EU geo profile, docs/CONTRACTS.md §19.5 and docs/DECISIONS.md ADR-40); profileRegions lists that profile's destination regions, for IAM. embeddingModel.modelId is in-Region and used as is (never prefixed with profilePrefix).
